subject: Agriculture
title: Gene Banks and Preservation
description: A quick, practical guide to Gene Banks and Preservation.

hook.text: The Svalbard Global Seed Vault holds 1.2 million seed samples inside an Arctic mountain. It's agriculture's backup drive.

buildup.text: Humans have cultivated 7,000 plant species for food. Today, just three—rice, wheat, corn—provide 50% of all calories.

discovery.text: Gene banks preserve wild crop relatives with traits—drought tolerance, disease resistance—that modern crops bred out.

twist.text: Syria's gene bank in Aleppo was partially destroyed in the civil war. Its backup seeds in Svalbard saved the collection.

climax.text: Climate change will demand new crop traits. Gene banks hold the genetic diversity that breeders will need.

punchline.text: 1.2 million seeds in a frozen vault. Humanity's insurance against the unknown.

quiz.question: How many seed samples does the Svalbard Global Seed Vault hold?
